name: 04005 · Biddeford, ME
findings: ZIP 04005 (Biddeford) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04005 (Biddeford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 04005 (Biddeford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
